/articles/library-hours.body:
Central Library extends Saturday hours

From November 7, the Central Library opens at 9 am on Saturdays, an hour earlier than before, and closes at 5 pm.

/articles/heat-pumps.body:
What a heat pump costs in Riverside

Installers in Riverside quoted between 9,000 USD and 14,000 USD for a whole-house air-source heat pump this autumn. The city rebate is 2,000 USD.
